email.title: Direct IMAP
email.description:
⚠️ **Mailbox privacy:** Daylight can read the full contents and supported attachments of every unread, undeleted message in the configured mailbox. We strongly recommend using a dedicated email address or folder used only for calendar imports. [Learn more about mailbox access and privacy](https://github.com/superdingo101/daylight-calendar-import/blob/main/docs/direct-imap.md#mailbox-privacy-and-access)

Connect a mailbox for Daylight to poll every five minutes. Messages are marked seen only after durable local handling.
